import json

enc = tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base")

def s(v):

        if not isinstance(meta, dict):

            au_str = ""

            au_str = ", ".join(s(x) for x in au)

            au_str = s(au)

        text = title + "\n" + abstract + "\n" + body + "\n" + kw_str + "\n" + au_str + "\n" + journal

print(f"TOTAL={total}")
with open("/app/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as out:
